full_judgment: 8. From the averments made in plaint it is clear that the plaintiffs are limited companies. In the case of Edward vs Hall Well reported in (1950) AER 1 1067 Jenkins LJ held that the right of a member not to be compelled to contribute beyond the limits of the liability which he undertook when he became a member is one of the individual rights of membership and it is indeed an individual membership right of the highest order because it cannot be overruled by a majority of even all the members other than the opposing one.
